values.note: Full hook-up (water, sewer, electric) $45 a night; tent/small-RV sites with water and electric, for tents, pop-ups or RVs up to about 24 ft, $35. Firewood $5 a bundle. 2026 season page, read 2026-10-20.

values.note: Online booking on the campground's own site (Premier Campground Management); holiday weekends by phone or text only (570-274-5995). No office hours or check-in: go straight to the site. Cancel more than 8 days out for a full refund less $5; 7-3 days, less the first night; under 3 days, no refund.

booking.source: http://www.pennscreekcampground.com/ ('The reservation system will be able to accept reservations for the entire 2026 camping season starting Mid-February! Holiday weekend reservations will continue to be by telephone only (or text)'; 'Book Now'; cancellation policy), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the 2026 $35 (water/electric, RVs to ~24 ft) and $45 full-hookup rates, water+sewer. Added online booking on the operator's site (holidays by phone/text), showers, April 15 opening, cancellation terms. Not stated: amperage, site count (50 left derived), closing date.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (contrary operator claim; entry is 'not waterfront'): http://www.pennscreekcampground.com/ says 'our beautiful campground located directly on Penns Creek', and site boundaries run 'from the meter base with your number on it DOWNSTREAM to the next meter base', suggesting sites strung along the creek.
Site length: the $35 water/electric sites take 'small RV's up to approx 24'' only; the full-hookup sites' length is not stated. 23 ft fits the cheap sites, barely.
